subject: Billing header & VAT update following Firwood acquisition
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@firwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Firwood Billing <billing@firwood.com>
Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 09:21:00 -0400
Subject: Update to invoice header, VAT certificate and remit instructions (Firwood -> Veridian)

Hi Mina / Monica,

Quick note from our side: Firwood was acquired by Veridian Holdings on 2027-04-30. As part of the integration we need future invoices and remittance instructions updated. Can Redwood do the following starting with invoices dated May 1 onward?

- Update invoice "bill to" to: Firwood Group, a Veridian Company
- Include Veridian VAT/Tax ID on invoices: EU-VAT-517-998 (VAT proof attached)
- Reissue invoices for April 2027 and early May to the new header if possible (we can provide PO crosswalks)
- Payment routing: bank remains the same but beneficiary now reads: "Firwood Group - Veridian Holdings" (bank details in attached memo)

Attached: Firwood_New_VAT_Certificate.pdf (official VAT cert) and Firwood_Change_of_Control_Memo.pdf (legal memo with effective date).

We know reissuing may have accounting implications; please advise what you need. Our preferred billing contact going forward is billing@firwood.com (cc'd). Carlos Vega from Veridian is on copy for treasury coordination.

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Director of Finance — Firwood Group

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@firwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 08:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Update to invoice header, VAT certificate and remit instructions (Firwood -> Veridian)

Elena — thanks for the heads up and congrats on the close.

A few quick items from our side to make this smooth:

1) We can update the invoice header and include the Veridian VAT/Tax ID on future invoices.
2) For reissuing prior invoices: we need a list of invoice numbers and the preferred reissue dates; Aditya (billing ops) will own the reissue queue.
3) For tax documentation: the VAT certificate you attached looks fine, but our finance team also needs the company registration showing the name change or an invoice instruction letter on firm letterhead.
4) If payments have already been processed for any of the invoices you want reissued, we will need confirmation that Firwood/Veridian accepts credit memos or reissue adjustments for bookkeeping.

Can you confirm the target for reissuance (e.g., reissue April invoices by 05/20) and share the invoice list? I will start a ticket with billing ops and loop in accounting.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Elena Ruiz <elena@firwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Firwood Billing <billing@firwood.com>, Carlos Vega <c.vega@veridian.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 11:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Update to invoice header, VAT certificate and remit instructions (Firwood -> Veridian)

Thanks Mina — attached is the invoice crosswalk and our requested reissue list.

Summary:
- Reissue invoices: RF-2027-0421, RF-2027-0430, RF-2027-0503
- Target reissue date: 2027-05-20
- Letter on firm letterhead: included as part of the Change_of_Control_Memo.pdf (see page 2)
- Payments: none of the three invoices have cleared yet; treasury will confirm if any wire in-flight needs to be reallocated.

Bank/Beneficiary note (for invoice footnote):
Beneficiary: Firwood Group - Veridian Holdings
IBAN: GB29NWBK60161331926819
SWIFT: NWBKGB2L

Attachments included in this email:
- Firwood_New_VAT_Certificate.pdf
- Firwood_Change_of_Control_Memo.pdf
- invoice_crosswalk.csv (list of invoice numbers + POs)

Please let us know if you need anything else. We appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Director of Finance, Firwood Group

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Update to invoice header, VAT certificate and remit instructions (Firwood -> Veridian)

Forwarding Elena's confirmation and attachments to accounts-payable queue. Action items I logged:

- Update customer record: bill_to_name -> "Firwood Group, a Veridian Company"; add Veridian VAT as secondary tax id.
- Upload VAT certificate and change-of-control memo to customer file.
- Reissue RF-2027-0421, RF-2027-0430, RF-2027-0503 with new header and VAT line; target processing 2027-05-20.
- Add invoice footnote with beneficiary banking language provided by Firwood.
- If a payment comes through before reissue, AP will hold funds and coordinate with Firwood treasury (Carlos Vega) — flagged in our AR system.

Attached: reissue_list.csv (internal template with invoice IDs and reissue reason).

Mina — please confirm your approval and I will mark this as scheduled. Monica — tagging you to check tax posting rules so GL mappings are correct on reissued invoices.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Billing Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
